playground.title: Playground
playground.subtitle: Chat with an agent turn by turn. Each thread is its own session, with every operation traced.
playground.noAgentsGuidance: Create an agent to start a chat and trace its turns.
playground.actAsHint: Optional. Tenant-less turns skip personal scopes and grants.
playground.emptyHint: Send one below; each operation of the turn appears in the trace.
playground.rebuiltNote: Earlier messages are rebuilt from this thread's trace payloads; anything the trace ring has dropped is not shown.
playground.noEventsMatch: No events match this filter yet.
playground.attachmentsNotShown: {n, plural, one {# attachment not shown} other {# attachments not shown}}
playground.statusTimedOut: turn timed out; the loop is still running
playground.statusStreamEnded: stream ended before the turn finished
playground.noErrorMessage: The runtime reported an error without a message.
playground.streamBroken:
stream: {message}

The turn may still be running on the runtime. Refresh the trace to see how far it got.
playground.noTurn: the runtime closed the stream without running a turn
playground.noTurnBubble: the runtime closed the stream without running a turn.
playground.noTurnActAs:
the runtime closed the stream without running a turn.

Act as user "{user}" is probably not a known profile.
